channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Neighbors push back on proposed 85-acre Indrio Town Center near I-95 in St. Lucie County
item.description: A proposed 85-acre development off Indrio Road and Russakis Road is moving closer to reality after county planning and zoning unanimously recommended rezoning the land from agricultural to planned retail workplace.

item.description: A proposed 85-acre development off Indrio Road and Russakis Road in St. Lucie County is moving closer to reality after the county planning and zoning commission unanimously recommended rezoning the land from agricultural to planned retail workplace on June 18. item.title: Indian River County waste management fees jump 93% for condo owners under new contract
item.description: Vero Beach condo owners saw their monthly waste management fees nearly double from $11 to $21 under a new county contract with Waste Management that began in October 2025.

item.title: St. Lucie County offers free rip current safety training at public pools this summer
item.description: The St. Lucie County Parks & Recreation Department is hosting three free sessions using a new rip current simulation machine at local pools to teach proper escape techniques.

item.title: Three lawsuits challenge Florida property tax amendment ballot language before November vote
item.description: Save Our Voters, former South Miami Mayor Philip Stoddard, and former lawmakers Jeff Brandes and Al Lawson filed separate lawsuits arguing Amendment Three's ballot language is biased and misleading.

item.title: Three lawsuits challenge Florida property tax amendment before November vote
item.description: Florida's property tax amendment backed by the state Legislature is now facing three lawsuits challenging whether the ballot language gives voters a fair explanation or a political sales pitch. Plaintiffs argue the ballot summary uses biased campaign-style language urging voters to support it.

item.title: US-Belgium World Cup match draws over 30 million viewers, sets US soccer record
item.description: Monday's United States-Belgium World Cup match was the most-watched soccer telecast in U.S. history, peaking at 36 million viewers early in the second half.

item.title: Lionel Messi leads Argentina to 3-2 comeback win over Egypt, advances to World Cup quarterfinals
item.description: Argentina overcame a two-goal deficit in the final 11 minutes to defeat Egypt 3-2, with Messi scoring his eighth goal of the tournament and Enzo Fernandez netting the winner in stoppage time.

item.title: United States eliminated from World Cup after 4-1 loss to Belgium in round of 16
item.description: Belgium's Charles De Ketelaere scored twice and assisted on another goal as the Red Devils knocked the United States out of the World Cup on Monday night at Lumen Field.

item.title: IOC ends neutral status vetting for Russian athletes ahead of 2028 Los Angeles Olympics
item.description: The International Olympic Committee advised Olympic sports bodies on Tuesday to end a three-year program vetting Russians for neutral status ahead of qualifying events for the 2028 LA Olympics.
